item.title: The Magdi Yacoub Global Heart Foundation Launches Campaign for the Future Health of the Middle East and Africa | Magdi Yacoub Global Heart Foundation
item.description: Washington, DC — To fuel the future of care and medicine in Egypt, the Middle East and Africa, the Magdi Yacoub Global Heart Foundation launched a campaign for the Magdi Yacoub Global Heart Centre in Cairo on Thursday, May 9, 2019. Founder Professor Sir Magdi Yacoub and Board Chair Dr. Magdy Ishak gathered friends, partners ... Read more
